_claude_projects_comment: THE one required key: your Claude Code transcript root(s), scanned as <root>/*/*.jsonl. Usually the '.claude/projects' folder inside your user profile (home directory), on any OS. Empty = the dashboard starts but lists nothing. Put your real value in config.local.json (gitignored) if you ever intend to commit this file.
_per_feature_comment: Everything below this line is OPTIONAL. Every key here ships empty on purpose - an empty value means that one surface reports 'not configured' and nothing else changes. Fill in only what you use; real paths belong in config.local.json (gitignored), which merges over this file.
_per_cli_comment: One key per extra CLI column: Codex session index jsonl(s); Hermes state.db; Copilot session-store.db + session-state dir; Antigravity main.log.
_workspace_roots_comment: Folders your projects live under. Scopes the hook audit and deletion monitoring, resolves bare folder names, and is the spawn allowlist: with this empty, 'open a new session' refuses every request (fail closed, both in monitor.py and tools/new_session.ps1). Also used to shorten project labels (<root>/my-proj shows as my-proj).

context_limits._comment: jsonl model field has no [1m] suffix, so we assume opus-4-8 runs the 1M window; adjust if you use the 200k tier

_hooks_comment: Hook 稽核頁（/hooks）。hooks_source_repo = hook 母本 repo，用它的 git 完整歷史判定「落後未部署」與「本地手改」的差別；不存在時頁面標母本不可用，不會假裝 custody 判得出來。掃描範圍沿用上面的 workspace_roots，並排除 git worktree（.git 是檔案者）。部署快照每日一筆寫進 _state/hooks/，只能從啟用當天往後累積。
_showcase_comment: 作品集網站一鍵更新（/showcase）。apps_root = 本機 apps repo 的路徑（底下要有 .showcase/reconcile.py），url = 它發佈出去的網址。兩個值本來寫死在 monitor.py 裡，對別台機器／別的帳號永遠是錯的，現在都在這裡。留空或整段拿掉 = /showcase 回報未設定，不會去跑一個沒人選的路徑。
_github_pr_comment: 辦公室「PR」區（第 4 欄第 2 列）的資料來源：GitHub 上還沒關的 PR，每個畫成一個小人，標出它卡在哪（可合併／等 CI／CI 失敗／衝突／計算中）。走 `gh api graphql` 一次查完整個帳號，由 /api/prs 隨需供應、依 poll_seconds 快取，永遠不進 build_status 主 poll。憑證只靠 `gh auth`，這裡不放也不讀任何 token —— 查詢用的是 author:@me，會解析成當下登入的那個人，所以別人 clone 走一個字都不用改，只要 `gh auth login`。scope 三選一：all／public／private（要不要把私人 repo 的 PR 放進來，選就好，不必自己寫 GitHub 查詢語法）；打錯字不會默默當成 all，該區會直接說不認得。query 是進階逃生口：填了就整條蓋掉 scope，直接送你自己的搜尋字串。enabled=false 則該區顯示為關閉，不會偷打網路。
_kb_comment: Knowledge-base repo root. Used ONLY by the on-demand /api/kb-today counter (git-based, cached 5 min, never in the main poll). Empty or missing = the KB card says so instead of showing a fake zero.
_kb_links_comment: KB 卡片下方的快速開啟連結。path 相對於 kb_dir，由 /kb/<path> 唯讀提供（realpath confine，副檔名白名單，不列目錄）。group 自由命名，同名會歸成一區。改這裡不需要動程式；檔案不在了會在卡片上顯示為失效，不會靜默 404。注意：「架構圖」群組不在這裡維護——它由 KB 的登記表 projects/_shared/devops/architecture-diagram-minimum-standard.md 即時推導（2026-07-30 起），KB 加圖這邊自動跟上。
_handoff_dir_comment: handoff_dir points at a directory of handoff notes; the 待處理 Handoff card lists the open ones. collect_handoff classifies by filename suffix (_DONE / _SUPERSEDED / _WITHDRAWN); anything without a closing suffix counts as open. Empty or unset = the card shows nothing. A common layout is a live/<repo>/ + archive/<repo>/ split, but any flat folder of *.md notes works.
_deeplink_comment: Base URL prefixed to the /session/<id> deep link in TG/ntfy alerts. EMPTY = no link in alerts (owner 2026-07-27: the alerts are read on a phone, which cannot open a localhost link). A localhost value is treated as empty by monitor.py. If you set a LAN/tailscale base, open the link then add ?token=... manually — the token is NEVER embedded in push messages (ntfy topics may be public).
_presets_comment: G2 一鍵批次啟動。project_dir 必在 spawn allowlist 的根目錄下（`monitor._validate_new_session_folder`，new_session.ps1 再驗一次）；agent type=claude|codex；mode 走既有白名單；prompt_template 選填（claude 開場 prompt / codex 首個指令）。claude agent 以 -n CC-<hex> 名綁定 session id（落 monitor.db spawns 表）；codex 僅標題、不可綁定。
_bind_window_comment: spawn 後等 claude 在 ~/.claude/sessions 註冊 -n 名的秒數；超時記 retryable（絕不記成功）。
_cockpit_comment: preset agents 開進這個命名 wt 視窗（一批一個 tab、agent 之間 split-pane 同屏）；不會動使用者目前的視窗。tab_color 品牌色。cockpit 觀看格（🛰 Cockpit 視圖）自己的輕量輪詢：poll_secs 秒、最多 max 張卡；只讀 byte-cap tail，不做整檔掃描。
_quiet_realert_comment: per-session cooldown (hours) for the quiet 'stopped' alert: a session that cycles running->stopped (loop/auto) re-pings at most once per this window. 12 = once per 12h per session.
_local_machine_comment: 這台機器在下面 machines 登錄簿裡的鑰匙(win/mac/company/home)。本機列不帶 machine 欄(那個欄位代表「這列是遠端 relay 進來的」),所以徽章鑰匙靠這裡自報;留空 = 沿用舊行為,退回用 OS 判斷(兩台 Windows 會長得一樣)。同時也是 office_machine / cmd_machine 的缺省來源。
_alerts_enabled_comment: false = 本機是 spoke:有看板但不推播(Telegram 與 ntfy 都不發,captcha_guard 那條也不發),並強制關掉 tg_control_enabled(Telegram getUpdates 只服務一個 consumer,搶輸的一方是永久退位)。管轄邊界要看清楚——它管不到:(1) office_push.py 是獨立行程,照樣把「化名後」的 snapshot 推去 relay (2) office relay 的拉取(只收不送) (3) bind_host 的區網暴露。所以它叫「不發告警」,不是「對外靜音」。放在這個 tracked 檔而不是 config.local.json,是因為後者的 JSON 解析錯誤會被靜默吞掉、退回預設 true。
_os_icons_comment: TG-alert OS glyph, keyed by auto-detected os. No Windows-logo emoji exists & custom emoji needs TG Premium — so Windows uses the text 'Win' (clearest free OS-specific marker). Form-factor (🖥️/💻) is the separate per-machine 'form' badge. Edit freely.
_office_comment: Remote company-machine source over ntfy relay. office_secret + office_ntfy_topic are SECRETS -> put them in config.local.json (flat, top-level). See docs/plan_office_relay_2026-06-13.md.
_office_stale_comment: MUST exceed the SLOWEST remote machine's push interval (else snapshots get forced to 'stale' between pushes and TG alerts never fire). Company pushes every ~10min (quota saving) -> 1500s = 2.5x, tolerates one missed push.

ops._comment: Services tab. *_whitelist = don't flag as suspicious (display only).
ops._ops_comment: kill_allowlist/task_allowlist = what the OPERATIONS mode may act on (deny-by-default; NEVER system procs). Separate from the display whitelists above.
